params.debt: Outstanding repayment owed to the lender
params.decayFactor: Per-second decay ×1e18; floor = start × decay^duration (~85% oracle)
params.duration: Auction lifetime seconds; expiry enforces the price floor
params.startBidRef: Bid reference at start ≈ collateral × ~105% oracle price

EXECUTOR().notice: Settlement executor (AxelarSettlementExecutor in production, manual in tests)

LIQ_FEE_BPS().notice: Liquidation fee in basis points — a constant, not a knob.

armAuction(bytes32,address,address,uint2.notice: Arm the Dutch-auction liquidation after a confirmed failed repayment pull. The order is built by the router's program builder — the same single source of truth as every other leg — and covers THIS draw's collateral only (bounded allowance).

isValidSignature(bytes32,bytes).notice: ERC-1271: the escrow "signs" exactly the auction orders it has armed.

lockFor(bytes32,address,uint256).notice: Lock collateral for a draw; pulls from the caller (the borrower).

release(bytes32).notice: Return collateral to the borrower after a successful repayment settlement.

sweepAuction(bytes32).notice: Waterfall once the auction halted at target: lender up to debt → liquidation fee → surplus collateral back to the borrower. Permissionless.
